note: Recorded before any execution. Each task runs runs_per_task times per model against deterministic fixtures (loopback web pages, a confined workspace, a GitHub stand-in); a run passes only when every check in its expect block holds. A role meets the bar when its pass rate is at least per_role_pass_rate. This measures the named model on these tasks only; it cannot establish general competence.
